caption: This drawing features a full-length women’s gown with a fitted bodice and a voluminous skirt. The dress is illustrated in shades of gray and black on a beige background, with a floral pattern covering the entire garment. The bodice has a square neckline trimmed with lace and three-quarter length sleeves ending in cuffs, also with lace edging. The front of the dress has a series of vertical panels with floral decorations, accentuating the fitted waist. The skirt is wide, flowing outward in ample, rounded folds, and is also covered with elaborate floral motifs consisting of large flowers and leaves. To the upper right of the main dress illustration, there is a smaller, single line drawing showing the back view of the dress. This smaller image outlines the back seams, the gathering at the waist, and the arrangement of the sleeves and neckline without any floral pattern or color shading. The neck and wrists of the figure are shown in plain beige with no facial features or hands visible.
title: Wedding Dress
